newsitem.title: UK: Shell hires Walter Thompson in Europe.
newsitem.headline: Shell hires Walter Thompson in Europe.

text.p: Shell International Ltd, part of the Royal Dutch/Shell group, said on Friday it had appointed J. Walter Thompson (JWT), part of the WPP Group Plc, as its sole agency for all branded advertising in Europe.

"JWT will handle advertising for Shell companies in a total of 30 countries across all of western Europe, Scandinavia, Eastern Europe -- including Russia and the Baltic states -- and Turkey" the oil major said in a statement.
Shell companies in Europe expect their total advertising expenditure handled by JWT to be in the range of $80 to $100 million per year.

The company decided to move all its European strategic and creative advertising to one agency after a three month review which included consideration of three rivals -- JWT, its WPP stablemate Ogilvy and Mather and French-owned Publicis.
